Tech Mahindra, Noida (May 2022- October 2022) Employment Summary:
Job Role: Senior Associate Technical Support Project name: AT&T Tier 2 Network Support
Domain: BPS
Key Roles/Responsibilities at Tech Mahindra : -Worked as Tier 2 Engineer for AT&T majorly US Business Clients -Troubleshooting the issues like Circuit down, Internet down, Degraded Services, slow Internet, Packet Loss, Certain Website/Application Not Reachable - Providing Information to Clients Related to their Services, Total Bandwidth of the Circuit, IP Block information for LAN/WAN side -Engaging different Teams as per the Identified Issue like Circuit/Backbone/MACD -Dispatching and Engaging Engineer to Customer Sites -Coordinating between different teams and providing latest update to the Client on their Ticket -Coordinating with Clients for the Closure of the tickets once the Issue looks Resolved as per the checks.
Wipro Technology, Pune (2019-2022) Employment Summary:
Job Role: Student Computer Applications Project name: Magneti Marelli , Olympus Corporation
Domain: Cloud and Infrastructure Services
Key Roles/Responsibilities at Wipro : -Prepare Daily Health Checkup report for core devices. -Prepare Weekly health status of all devices and taking backup of configuration -Monitoring for the health and alarms of all network devices. -Handling all priority Alerts and Alarms
-Creating and managing Network Device Inventories -Configuration VLANS (Layer2/Layer 3) -Configuration of SNMP
Page 1 of 3
-Troubleshooting routing (WAN links, Neighbor ship stability, routing protocols) and switching issues. - Contacted respective service provider, Local IT engineers for relevant network checks, providing them entire network details. - Dealt with user reported network issues. - Troubleshooting issues like site-down, link flaps, slow response, high utilization, Access
point unknown, switch down and packet drops, Vlan Mapping, Access Port Configurations - Opening TAC/Vendor/ISP Cases on High Priority Incidents -Providing remote access to Cisco Devices through Telnet & SSH.
Responsible for modifying services as per the customer requests. -Keeping sites or devices under maintenance, stopping management traffic temporarily. Providing unused IP/Subnet as per the Requirements -Monitoring and Basic checks on Viptela Sdwan Vmanage and VEdge (OMP, BFD Flaps, TLOC, Tunnel interface Utilizations etc) -Creating Changes and Representing the same on CAB Calls and to other Technical Teams
Tools: ➢Monitoring Tool: Service Now, Jira, Science Logic, Summit
➢Network Management Tool: Solarwinds, Cisco V-Manage, IPAM, Cisco Prime, Splunk,
➢Others: Putty, MS Visio, Pingsweep Utility, Sharepoint, Secure CRT
